buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of

documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. OEM's Authorisation Form The bidder shall submit a Bid-Specific Original Equipment Manufacturer's Authorisation Form (MAF) issued on the official letterhead of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), duly signed and stamped by an a uthorised signatory. The OEM Authorisation Form shall clearly indicate the bidder's name, complete comm unication address, bid reference number and other relevant particulars. It shall also contain the name, des ignation, official email address and contact number of the authorised signatory of the OEM. The Procuring Authority reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the authorisation directly with the OEM. 2. Submission of Mandatory Documents The bidder shall upload all requisite certificates, declarations and supporting documents as prescribed in t he Bid Document, Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) and any corrigendum issued thereto. Failure to s ubmit any mandatory document may render the bid liable for rejection, subject to the applicable GeM term s and conditions. 3. PAN and Odisha GST Registration Certificate The bidder shall submit a copy of its valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) and Odisha Goods and Servic es Tax (GST) Registration Certificate, as applicable under the prevailing statutory provisions. 4. Local Presence in Odisha The bidder shall have an established office or service support facility within the State of Odisha to ensure t imely delivery, installation and after-sales service support. Documentary evidence of such establishment s hall be furnished, wherever required under the approved bid conditions. 5. Submission of Fraudulent or Forged Documents If any document, certificate, declaration or information submitted by the bidder is found to be false, forged , fabricated or misleading at any stage of the procurement process, the bid shall be liable for rejection. Fur ther action may be initiated against the bidder in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and condition s and relevant Government rules. 6. Right of the Procuring Authority The Procuring Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any bid or to cancel the bidding process, in w hole or in part, at any stage before the award of contract, in accordance with the applicable procurement r ules and GeM terms and conditions. Any such decision shall be taken for valid and recorded reasons. 7. Must Provide 3 Years OEM Onsite Warranty. .
